name: anubis-fast
description: Anubis Fast Firefox extension and native messaging bridge

scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:solver && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:firefox:xpi: npm run build:firefox && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const dist='dist';const zips=fs.readdirSync(dist).filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.zip')).sort();if(zips.length===0)throw new Error('No zip artifact found in dist');const zipPath=path.join(dist,zips.at(-1));const xpiPath=zipPath.replace(/\.zip$/,'.xpi');fs.copyFileSync(zipPath,xpiPath);console.log('Created',xpiPath);"
